old_render = '''def render_inner_html(elem):
    """Render the inner HTML of an element (excluding the tag itself)."""
    from markdown import util
    inner = []
    if elem.text:
        inner.append(elem.text)
    for child in elem:
        inner.append(util.etree.tostring(child, encoding='unicode'))
        if child.tail:
            inner.append(child.tail)
    return ''.join(inner)'''

new_render = '''def render_inner_html(elem):
    """Render the inner HTML of an element (excluding the tag itself)."""
    inner = []
    if elem.text:
        inner.append(elem.text)
    for child in elem:
        inner.append(etree.tostring(child, encoding='unicode'))
        if child.tail:
            inner.append(child.tail)
    return ''.join(inner)'''

content = content.replace(old_render, new_render)

with open('markdown/extensions/toc.py', 'w') as f:
    f.write(content)

print("Fixed render_inner_html")
